Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Alchemist's Gambit and returning the original Alchemist's Gambit to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Alchemist's Gambit from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.
